rationale: The only candidate (9e96ee69c81d) is a typing clean-up that removes cast() calls and wraps header reads in a _required() None check; it reformats the blamed queue-default expression without fixing any behaviour this change got wrong.
60b3d6816b0a replaces OpenUV's custom data object with DataUpdateCoordinators, an architectural refactor that makes the manual async_update method unnecessary rather than fixing a defect in it.
92df1c10173a changes read_csv's default file filtering and wraps open_csv in a try/except to give a clearer ValueError, a UX/feature change that only re-indents the blamed open_csv call.
40596f05dd94 merges DDPSpawnStrategy into DDPStrategy and deletes the whole file, a refactor; the blamed _set_world_ranks signature was not shown to be defective.

The change is a revert that restores defensive copy=True slicing as a workaround for an Arrow serialization bug; 75b206e419f8 drops the copy once a custom serializer is in place, a performance clean-up, not a fix of a defect the revert introduced.
aae800d988bc removes the deprecated CategoricalBlock __getattr__ shim as part of a deprecation clean-up; the blamed find_stack_level() call was not faulty.

fe07466a1449 rewrites the region-to-control producer as a silo-mode service abstraction; its best-effort ModuleDeadlock import fix concerns module-level imports, not the blamed None-guard or the REGION-only check.

The change hard-coded 'lightning-app'/'lightning_app' for editable-install and git-dir detection, and bd658441bd01 parameterises it with default 'lightning'; this may repair broken packaging detection for the main package, but it is mixed with new standalone-package support, so the evidence does not show whether the hard-coding was a defect or an intentional interim CI setting.

The change passed mode=brotli.BrotliEncoderMode.TEXT, which the brotli Python module does not define, so the call raises AttributeError; the same-day fix switches to brotli.MODE_TEXT, and spotting this needs knowledge of the brotli library API.

Candidate 1 changes the inactive send rate to 10Hz (a behaviour improvement) and candidate 3 is a clean-up; candidate 2 switches counter initialisation from the camera-bus counter this change introduced to the powertrain-bus counter for 'reliable relay open init', which may repair an LKAS-fault case, but its message does not show whether it fixes a defect or tunes behaviour.
01b1c6512c15 deletes the whole DynamicSamplingFeatureMultiplexer module as a refactor; nothing indicates get_enabled_user_biases was defective.

The refactor set bs = len(dataset) for LoadImages too, making the batch size the number of files instead of 1 (this breaks non-PyTorch backends such as TensorRT, which warm up with batch size bs); the fix restores bs = 1 except for streams, and seeing this needs the dataset's __len__ and the later uses of bs elsewhere in the file and repository.
